notes.title: Patch Notes 6-3-2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a spelling mistake, was spelled LIVES REAMAINING.
[*] Adjustment to V90-SMG, reduced the recoil slightly for hip fire and ADS fire.
[*] Adjustment to Dome Seeker precision rifle, reduced the recoil and a slight sound adjustment.
[*] Adjustment to SMG-90R, reduced the recoil for hip fire.
[*] Reduced bullet spread for AR-CX4 and AKX-77 while hip firing
[*] Wall climbing speed increased by 20%
[*] Fixed an issue with the grapple where gliding near the ground would trigger the landing audio cue.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.0.11 Patch Notes - 5-10-2024
notes.content:
1.0.0.11 Patch Notes - 5-10-2024
Features:
[list]
[*] Added a Final Results page when your run ends.
[/list]
Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Enemies now get stronger when you secure zones. Before it was on a timer.
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where headshots were not tracked correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where stages completed under 7:00 now track correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing the START button on a controller when starting a new run after a run is finished.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn’t start a new run if at max level.
[/list]
Balance Changes:
[list]
[*] Changed a challenge: complete a stage under 5:00 -> 7:00.
[/list]
UI/UX:
[list]
[*] Added an option under UI settings to turn off enemy outlines.
[/list]
Visuals:
[list]
[*] Made some lighting adjustments on Alpine Ridge.
[*] Made some lighting adjustments on High Altitude.
[/list]
